ouroboros.contracts.v1.ConversationTurn..description: ConversationTurn is one committed private history entry.

answer.description: answer is the committed assistant result for completed assistant turns.

occurredAt.description: occurred_at records when the turn was committed.

role.description: role distinguishes principal input from synthesized assistant output.
role.title: Conversation Role

sequence.description: sequence is monotonic within the session.

sessionId.description: session_id names the owning authenticated session.

status.description: status distinguishes completed turns from visibly failed interruptions.
status.title: Conversation Turn Status

text.description: text is the bounded user input; assistant turns never carry it.

turnId.description: turn_id is the opaque committed turn identity.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ConversationTurn..title: Conversation Turn

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.description: Cursor pins an ordered replay or status position without exposing storage internals.

token.description: token is an opaque bounded continuation token.

watermark.description: watermark is the inclusive canonical event watermark observed by the caller.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.title: Cursor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.description: CodeAnchor identifies an immutable Git tree and optional precise source range.

gitOid.description: git_oid identifies an immutable commit or tree.

range.description: range identifies the source span when available.

symbolId.description: symbol_id identifies a resolved code symbol when available.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceAnchor.Co.title: Code Anchor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.description: EvidenceRef identifies evidence metadata and optionally one precise anchor.

anchorDigest.description: anchor_digest identifies an optional canonical anchor serialization.

evidenceId.description: evidence_id is an opaque evidence identity.

sourceRevisionId.description: source_revision_id identifies the immutable source revision.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.EvidenceRef.jsons.title: Evidence Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.description:
FactualConsistencyProvenance pins the implementation and calibration bytes
 behind one numeric factual-consistency result. It never identifies evidence.

calibrationDigest.description: calibration_digest binds the immutable calibration artifact bytes.

calibrationId.description: calibration_id identifies the declared calibration population and method.

scorerId.description: scorer_id is a stable implementation family, not a floating provider alias.

scorerVersion.description: scorer_version pins the exact scoring behavior.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.title: Factual Consistency Provenance

evaluatedClaimCount.description: evaluated_claim_count is the number of fully evaluated claims.

provenance.description: provenance is required only for a scored result.

reason.description: reason is unspecified only for a scored result.
reason.title: Factual Consistency Reason

scorePerMille.description: score_per_mille is a calibrated [0, 1000] estimate when status is SCORED.

status.description: status distinguishes scored, answer abstention, and unknown outcomes.
status.title: Factual Consistency Status

totalClaimCount.description: total_claim_count is the bounded answer claim count presented to scoring.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.FactualConsistenc.title: Factual Consistency Score

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetHistorySuccess.description: GetHistorySuccess contains one page of the caller's own committed turns.

nextCursor.description: next_cursor continues within the same private history.

turns.description: turns contains only turns owned by the authenticated principal.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GetHistorySuccess.title: Get History Success

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedAnswerCla.description: GroundedAnswerClaim is one bounded material answer assertion and its support.

authorityClass.description: authority_class is always AUTHORITY_CLASS_MODEL_PROPOSAL at this boundary.
authorityClass.title: Authority Class

citations.description: citations provide exact authorized support; unsupported claims are discarded.

claimId.description: claim_id is an opaque claim identity within one answer.

confidencePerMille.description: confidence_per_mille is a disclosed calibrated estimate in [0, 1000].

statement.description: statement is the bounded material assertion text.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedAnswerCla.title: Grounded Answer Claim

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedCitation..description: GroundedCitation binds one claim to exact authorized committed-code evidence.

anchor.description: anchor pins the exact committed Git object and line/column range.

evidence.description: evidence identifies the cited immutable evidence and source revision.

supportingTextDigest.description: supporting_text_digest binds the hydrated supporting bytes without prose.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GroundedCitation..title: Grounded Citation

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryAnswer.jsons.description: QueryAnswer is the bounded grounded result: answered, partial, or abstained.

claims.description: claims is the bounded complete material-claim set for the prose.

degradedReasons.description: degraded_reasons discloses partial or abstention causes from a bounded set.

factualConsistency.description: factual_consistency discloses a calibrated score or explicit non-score.

prose.description: prose is the rendered answer; every material span maps to a claim.

queryId.description: query_id echoes the server-authored admitted query identity.

status.description: status distinguishes answered, disclosed partial, and abstained results.
status.title: Answer Status

ouroboros.contracts.v1.QueryAnswer.jsons.title: Query Answer

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.description: SourceRange identifies a source-code range using one-based line and column values.

endColumn.description: end_column is a one-based exclusive column number.

endLine.description: end_line is a one-based exclusive line number.

path.description: path is a repository-relative source path.

startColumn.description: start_column is a one-based inclusive column number.

startLine.description: start_line is a one-based inclusive line number.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SourceRange.jsons.title: Source Range
